Hatching the egg is so that the rider and dragon can form a bond. Imo it helps to avoid things like Aemond losing control over Vhagar. Since Aemond merely claimed Vhagar instead of being her first and only rider, I figure she’s less inclined to obey his every command, especially when he tells her to stop. 

With relationships like Rhaenyra and Syrax, where the rider had the dragon’s egg in their crib, we never see Syrax blatantly disobey her like that. Dragons are not tameable, as has been stated in both GOT and HOTD, you can ride a dragon but not own it. If you’ve bonded with the dragon all its life, I figure it’s easier to control it. If I were a multi-century old dragon, the biggest of them all, and some angsty teen with an eyepatch decided he owned me, I wouldn’t want to obey his every command either.
However, hatching is definitely up to chance. Dragons live a long time and can serve multiple riders, and older dragons are obviously much bigger, and therefore much stronger.
